verdict.rationale: The evidence shows cap table management, document uploads tied to transactions, Excel report exports, and per-stakeholder dashboards of their own holdings. None of it documents a permissioned data room for sharing cap table views plus underlying documents with counsel or investors. Stakeholder dashboards and exports are adjacent features, not the shared diligence data room the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors
